messages:
Emily (Marketing Lead): Ok team — Q2 GTM alignment thread. I want clear asks: sales target, major launch windows, PLG experiments we’ll run, and enablement we need for field by Apr 15. TL;DR: build a pared roadmap we can sign off in next week.
Raj (Head of Sales): Sounds good. Quick ask — can we lock a commit target for Dedicated customers? sales ops needs a number for quota planning.
Maria (Product): If we commit to Dedicated promos, we need the Canary rollout plan and a fallback model for SLOs. That affects launch timing.
Devon (Growth): PLG experiments I recommend: 1) trial credit bump for first 5k tokens, 2) in-product usage nudges tied to templates, 3) email drip for high-activity orgs. Small MVTs.
Nina (Solutions Eng): For the field: one-pager on security/compliance + 2 demo scripts (hosted vs dedicated). Can have drafts by Mar 28.
Raj (Head of Sales): Target ask: net-new ARR goal of $2.5M for Q2 from PLG-sourced expansions + $1.5M from committed seats (Dedicated). Is that aggressive?
Emily (Marketing Lead): That feels reasonable if we coordinate promo and enablement. We should also define a launch cohort (top 30 accounts) for Dedicated outreach.
Maria (Product): Can we set launch criteria for Dedicated GA: 99.9% uptime in staging for 7 days, quantized model variant tested for 50k tokens/day with <5% tail latency regressions, and docs + release notes.
Devon (Growth): For PLG experiments we need a gated metric list: activation (first meaningful call), 7-day retention, and expansion rate. We should A/B test credit bump vs templates.
Raj (Head of Sales): Sales motion: SDRs to run targeted sequences to accounts hitting 50k tokens/mo in free plan. Need list from Growth by Apr 1.
Nina (Solutions Eng): Note: some enterprise prospects require KMS/HSM proof points. Can we get security checklist finalized? That will affect dedicated sales cycles.
gtm-bot: Reminder: Q2 planning doc draft due Fri at 5pm.
Emily (Marketing Lead): Scope negotiation: Product, can we defer deep metrics dashboard for Public API until Q3 if we prioritize Dedicated enablement now?
Maria (Product): Yes — can deprioritize dashboard v2 if we commit resource to Dedicated rollout and can keep a lightweight analytics surface for initial customers.
Devon (Growth): Marketing ops note: Paid ads budget needs to be reallocated to PLG content and top-of-funnel templates. Recommend moving 30% from generic awareness budget.
Raj (Head of Sales): Field enablement ask: playbook + objection handling doc + 1 internal kickoff webinar. Timeline: playbook by Apr 8, webinar Apr 12.
Nina (Solutions Eng): I can produce playbook + 2 demo scripts by Apr 8. Need product signoff week of Apr 3.
Maria (Product): Confirming signoff window Apr 3–5. Also we need a canary rollback checklist included in the playbook.
Emily (Marketing Lead): Launch assets: blog post, customer case study (1), product page updates, 3 marketing templates. Who owns case study?
Raj (Head of Sales): I'll surface a customer candidate — likely a mid-market account we converted in Jan. Sales will own case study coordination.
Devon (Growth): Quick experiment: surface a "Get Dedicated" CTA in the usage dashboard for accounts over threshold and track click-through->sales conversion. Can we ship small flag by Apr 10?
Maria (Product): Engineering estimate for CTA flag: 3 dev days + 1 QA day. Feasible if we prioritize.
Emily (Marketing Lead): Risks: if Dedicated rollout slips we lose sales momentum. Mitigations: early access program + limited-time pricing for committed conversions.
Raj (Head of Sales): Agree. We also need a conversion SLA from product (ETA on feature parity for API).
Maria (Product): We'll provide a parity checklist and ETA in the planning doc.
Devon (Growth): Measurement: weekly dashboard for PLG experiments — Activation, Conversion to paid, ARR velocity. Growth ops will maintain.
Nina (Solutions Eng): One more note: demo infra needs a scrubbed dataset for Dedicated demos — ops help required.
Emily (Marketing Lead): Actions and owners recap: 1) Sales list for outreach — Raj — due Apr 1. 2) Playbook + demos — Nina — Apr 8. 3) CTA flag implementation — Eng/Product — Apr 10. 4) Case study — Raj + Marketing — Apr 12. 5) PLG experiments plan + measurement — Devon — Apr 5. 6) Canary rollout plan + rollback checklist — Maria — Apr 5. 7) Security checklist & KMS docs — Product/Security — Apr 6.
Raj (Head of Sales): Happy with owners. Can we get a weekly sync (15m) starting Mar 29 to keep momentum?
Maria (Product): Put it on calendar.
Devon (Growth): I'll prep the experiment brief and share in this channel.
Emily (Marketing Lead): Thanks all. If no objections I'll consolidate this thread into the Q2 GTM doc and share by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Raj (Head of Sales): :thumbsup:
Nina (Solutions Eng): +1
Maria (Product): +1
Devon (Growth): +1
